probes.check: am_probe_jolt_diagnostics(): a message traced through JPH::Trace reaches the facade and, when Jolt's assertions are compiled in (JPH_ENABLE_ASSERTS), JPH::AssertFailed is the facade's hook. Without assertions the result passes on the trace alone and its reason says the assert hook wasn't checked.

seeded_violation.description: Remove the JPH::Trace assignment from am_bind_jolt_diagnostics().

adaptation_notes: JPH::Trace takes a printf-style format; the glue formats it into a buffer before passing it to the facade.
JPH::AssertFailed exists only when Jolt is built with JPH_ENABLE_ASSERTS, which Jolt's CMake turns on for Debug builds; wrap the assignment in JPH_IF_ENABLE_ASSERTS.
